name: Eternal Blaze Garuda
description: A divine bird of eternal flame, Eternal Blaze Garuda soars above the stadium on wings of living fire. Its unbreakable stamina and iron-wing defense outlast every challenger, burning brighter the closer it comes to the edge.

special_move.name: Blazing Eternal Storm
special_move.description: Garuda spreads its divine wings to their full span, unleashing a tempest of sacred fire — each strike drains 1 Stamina from the enemy and heals Garuda for 30 HP, then engulfs the stadium in immortal flame!
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Blazing Eternal Storm** — Garuda ignites the sky!
🌪️ **Strike 2** — Sacred winds drain the enemy's spirit!
💥 **Strike 3** — The divine flames roar louder than thunder!
✨ **Strike 4** — BLAZING ETERNAL STORM — WINGS OF THE IMMORTAL FLAME!

abilities.name: Eternal Flame
abilities.description: Garuda's wings radiate heat at all times, reducing every incoming hit by 20, and it recovers +2 Stamina per turn. The first time HP drops below 40%, the flames surge once: heals 40 HP instantly and grants +30 DEF for the rest of the battle.

chain._note: Eternal Flame surge: heal 40 HP when below 40% HP
Eternal Flame surge: +30 Defense permanently after threshold crossed

abilities.name: Iron Wing Veil
abilities.description: When Garuda wins a defense, its iron wings reflect the force — dealing 15 TRUE damage to the attacker and restoring +1 Stamina. Every 4th successful defense releases a radiant burst that heals 25 HP, then the count resets.

abilities.name: Blazing Wing Strike
abilities.description: Each hit of Blazing Eternal Storm burns 1 Stamina from the enemy and heals Garuda for 30 HP — 4 hits, so 4 Stamina burned and 120 HP healed.
